name: demo-restaurant-scanner
description: DEMO Cafe & Restaurant — Dine-in QR Menu Scanner & Ordering System

scripts.build: npm --prefix qr-menu-frontend install && npm --prefix qr-menu-frontend run build && rm -rf dist && cp -r qr-menu-frontend/dist ./dist && rm -f ./dist/_redirects ./dist/200.html
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix qr-menu-backend run dev" "npm --prefix qr-menu-frontend run dev"
